facts.material: hexane-1,3,6-tricarbonitrile (CAS 1772-25-4), separate chemically defined organic compound, purity 99.5% or more

gri_path: GRI 1: a separate chemically defined organic compound (chapter 29 note 1(a)) with nitrile functional groups falls in heading 2926 nitrile-function compounds
GRI 6: 2926.90 other (not acrylonitrile, 1-cyanoguanidine, fenproporex, isophthalonitrile etc.)
GRI 6: aliphatic compound, not aromatic, so not the 2926.90.01-48 aromatic lines (and not a section VI additional U.S. note 3 product); 2926.90.50 other; suffix .50 other (not malononitrile)

rejected_alternatives.reason: aromatic nitrile lines; hexanetricarbonitrile is aliphatic
product is a single chemically defined compound of high purity, not a mixture/prepared electrolyte

classification.rationale: Hexane-1,3,6-tricarbonitrile is a separate chemically defined aliphatic organic compound whose characteristic groups are nitriles, so it falls in heading 2926 under chapter 29 note 1(a). Its battery-additive use does not remove it from chapter 29 since it is imported pure and unmixed. Among the 2926.90 lines it is non-aromatic, so it takes 2926.90.50, and the residual suffix .50, consistent with NY E88551 placing an aliphatic nitrile in 2926.90.5050.
